notes.title: Demo Update! - Unlockable Costumes and General Improvements
notes.content: A substantial update for WARRIOR SPIRIT's demo is now live! There are now unlockable colors for WARRIOR SPIRIT (The demo only features Red and Yellow- the rest are in the full game). You'll have to find them though. Also, other things like Aiming and Lock-On have been improved as well. Enjoy!

notes.title: NEW and Improved Demo!
notes.content:
New Demo Features:



New Playable Area: Blossom Castle
Entirely New Level in Super Sponge Spire
Gameplay Additions and Tweaks to the Wall-Running
New Visual Effects
Additional SFX
General Additions and Improvements to the game all-around


It has about double the content as the last demo. There are many new features and improvements. Whether you've played the last demo or this is your first time seeing WARRIOR SPIRIT, you should try it out!

notes.title: Update: Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
This update fixes various bugs and improves the game overall.

- Fixed miscellaneous bugs
- Improved Animation for Dash-Down / High-Jump
- Added small details to Cacti Caverns
- Tweaked several hit-boxes to improve gameplay experience
- Improved the tutorialization text
- Improved some of the game's Spanish localization

notes.title: UPDATE: Upgraded Graphics and new Accessibility Features
notes.content:
Features and changes:

- Added a Keyboard + Mouse Controller Guide to the Pause Menu
- Added Color Blind Mode
- Improved the graphics of Calibration Course
